title: exudev scripts --check looks like it failed with an error when it only found something
author: Claude-JG
description: maintainer 2026-10-10: '.\exudev.bat scripts --check ..\..\teaching\Innsbruck\Maschinendynamik_WS2019\' gives an error. Measured: no exception - 79 scripts checked, 504 findings, and --check returns 1 as designed; conda run then prints 'ERROR conda.cli.main_run:execute(125): ... failed. (See above for error)' and the summary FAILED, which read as a crash of the tool
releaseNotes: exudev scripts --check says that it failed because the scripts need changes (a closing line, the verdict 'FAILED: scripts need changes'), and every exudev step explains conda's ERROR line as the passed-on exit code. revision2026c step RG10.31.10
